verdict.rationale: Capacities documents an official MCP integration: developers can connect their own app, agent, or bot to a space by implementing an MCP client against it. Chat Connectors also link ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Le Chat to a space, and a probe confirms an official MCP server page exists. missing for 10: details on the exposed MCP tools/capabilities and on MCP-specific auth/transport setup, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
